vacancies.title: Senior Product Designer (part-time)

verdict.text: The core matches; the unknowns are the portfolio link, A/B testing and the pay.

would_change: If the pay for 20 hours a week is below the saved minimum, skip.
If the portfolio isn't shareable, the application is weak whatever the CV says.

requirements.evidence: Product designer, 5 years, B2B SaaS and mobile apps

requirements.requirement: Strong portfolio of shipped B2B products
requirements.note: No portfolio link in the CV

requirements.requirement: Experience building and scaling design systems
requirements.evidence: Built and maintained a design system in Figma with 120 components

requirements.requirement: Experience with quantitative research and A/B testing
requirements.evidence: Redesigned the onboarding flow, increasing activation from 31% to 44%
requirements.note: A measured result, but no mention of how it was tested

cv_fixes.text: Add the portfolio link at the top; it is usually the first thing opened.
If the activation lift came from an A/B test, say so in the same line.

new.text: Mentoring juniors and scaling design systems

same: Design systems, onboarding and usability work
unknown: Who sets product direction and whether designers talk to users

red_flags.text: Pay is not stated; the hours cap may stretch in practice.

vacancies.money: Contract, 20 hours per week, remote. Pay not stated.

questions.question: What is the pay for 20 hours a week, gross or net?
Is the contract renewed, and for how long?
Do designers have direct access to users, and who decides what gets built?

talking_points.cv: Built and maintained a design system in Figma with 120 components
talking_points.vacancy: Experience building and scaling design systems

talking_points.cv: Redesigned the onboarding flow, increasing activation from 31% to 44%

talking_points.point: Say what the research was and nothing more.
talking_points.vacancy: Experience with quantitative research and A/B testing

decide.question: Can you share a portfolio of shipped B2B products?
decide.affects: Whether the portfolio requirement is met
